parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token used to start the next query. If the amount of data exceeds the limit, this parameter is returned for you to query the next page.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of resource N. In this context, the resource ID is the cluster ID. You can query multiple resources at a time by specifying ResourceId.2, ResourceId.3, and so on. N is a positive integer.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag to query. You can specify multiple keys. N is a positive integer.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag to query. You can specify multiple values. N is a positive integer.
